launch_cifar10_experiment: launch an XManager experiment to train a CIFAR10 model on 8 TPU v2 cores
create_experiment_cifar10: create an XManager experiment titled cifar10 using xm_local.create_experiment
package_python_container: package a Python container with ubuntu:20.04 base image and TPU VM docker instructions
run_hyperparameter_trials: run hyperparameter trials over learning rates 0.1 and 0.001 on TPU v2 with 8 cores
configure_tensorboard_logging: configure Tensorboard logging for XManager jobs with a named tensorboard instance
